text:
Some AI models don't write you a paragraph. They hand you a decision.

This month Cloudflare and Strands both released open decision models: you give it text, JSON, or an image, and it returns a typed answer with probabilities. No essay. The 2B one runs on your own machine, Apache 2.0, free.

Try this week: pick one yes/no call in your workflow, like "is this email urgent?" or "does this clip need a human?", and let a small local model make it.

The chat window was never the only interface.
